Fix GitHub issue #33 in this repository (codecoradev/tole).

## Issue #33 (embedded — you have no tool to read issues)

Title: docs: README status line stale — says Phase 0 while Phase 2 is nearly complete

The README (README.md, 12 lines) currently says:
  Status: Phase 0 - blueprint and scaffold.

Reality: Phase 1a/1b (E1-E6) and Phase 2 (E7 tools, E10 loop guard, E11
secret redaction, E4.5 tool calling, E12 edit_file/delete_file) are all
merged into develop. The status line is stale and misleading.

## Your task

1. Read README.md with read_file. Note the content hash it returns.
2. Use edit_file to change ONLY the status line from
     Status: Phase 0 - blueprint and scaffold.
   to
     Status: Phase 2 - tools and MVP gate (agent harness live).
   Quote the hash from step 1 as old_hash. Use the exact current status
   line as old_text and the new line as new_text. Do not rewrite the
   whole file.
3. Verify: read README.md again and confirm the status line is updated.
4. Report the final content hash of README.md.
5. Leave a comment on issue #33 via the gh tool (op=issue_comment,
   number="33") stating: what line changed, old hash -> new hash, and
   that the change was made with edit_file (hash-anchored).

## Rules
- Only touch README.md. Nothing else.
- After step 5 you are done. Stop and summarize.

Fixes #33 via PR docs/e8-readme-status (created by the maintainer from
your session).

# tole

Durable Rust agent harness: write-once conversation tree + register state machine over JSONL session files, with risk-tiered approval gates.

Status: Phase 0 - blueprint and scaffold.

## Workspace
- crates/tole-core - platform-agnostic lib (state machine, storage, Tool/Approver traits)
- crates/tole-cli - headless CLI host

## Design sources
Research notes and design sources: adapted from pi's harness spec (MIT).
